children: Waste Management reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $6.85 billion, up 6.3% year over year, and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.15. Adjusted operating EBITDA increased 5.8% to $2.12 billion, while reported net income was $820 million. The company affirmed its 2026 guidance, projecting revenue and free cash flow toward the high ends of their ranges.
Revenue was $6.846 billion, compared with $6.443 billion in the third quarter of 2025.
Income from operations was $1.279 billion as reported and $1.329 billion on an adjusted basis.
Net income attributable to Waste Management was $820 million as reported and $858 million on an adjusted basis.
Adjusted diluted EPS was $2.15, compared with $1.98 a year earlier; reported diluted EPS was $2.05.
Adjusted operating EBITDA rose 5.8% to $2.121 billion. Net cash provided by operating activities was $4.87 billion for the first nine months, and free cash flow was $3.01 billion.

Collection and Disposal volume declined 0.4%, or 0.5% on a workday-adjusted basis, reflecting the planned exit from lower-margin residential business and commercial declines related largely to prior national account broker losses.

Pricing remained a key revenue driver: core price was 5.8%, while Collection and Disposal yield was 3.4%. Higher energy surcharges and volumes in recycling and renewable energy also contributed to growth.
Healthcare Solutions benefited from cost management, synergy capture and pricing growth. The company cited continued progress integrating the business and improving its operations.
Waste Management began operations at a new renewable natural gas facility in New York, its 18th new facility completed since 2022.

The company expects 2026 revenue of $26.275 billion to $26.475 billion, adjusted operating EBITDA of $8.15 billion to $8.25 billion, and free cash flow of $3.75 billion to $3.85 billion. It expects revenue and free cash flow at the high ends of their ranges.

title: Waste Management Q3 Revenue Rises 6.3% to $6.85 Billion
